title: Suricatoos — Fleet Node Heartbeat
description: POST /fleet/v1/heartbeat (ADR-0011), outbound mTLS, every heartbeat_interval_s (default 60). The request carries the current content_sha256 of every state kind the node has; the hub compares them with the snapshots it holds and lists in 'resync' the kinds it wants re-sent in full (PUT /fleet/v1/state/{kind}). Both sides announce schema_versions in EVERY heartbeat and EVERY heartbeat response, and each speaks the highest version common to the other side's latest announcement. A JSON body whose schema_version the hub does not support (on any route) gets 426 with $defs/version_unsupported, the hub's announcement; that shape and the schema_versions member are version-invariant. server_time is used ONLY to report clock_offset_s and raise an alert: the node never adjusts the clock it verifies command windows with to the hub's. node_id must equal the CN of the client certificate. The root accepts any of the three messages; implementations validate the specific $defs entry.

schema_versions.description: versions the NODE supports (may change after an upgrade)

replay_floor.description: the node's replay floor: set at every (re)enroll and whenever the anti-replay store was unreadable or missing at boot; the node rejects as replay any command with issued_at < replay_floor + its skew. NORMATIVE for the hub: never issue a command for this node with issued_at < replay_floor + 10 min (the FLEET_CLOCK_SKEW ceiling), nor before it has seen the replay_floor that follows a (re)enroll

state_hashes.description: kind -> content_sha256 of the node's latest snapshot of that kind

outbox_events.description: events waiting in the durable outbox

outbox_dropped.description: events dropped since start because the outbox cap was hit (oldest first)

pending_results.description: acks/results/artifacts not yet accepted by the hub

unauthenticated_rejections.description: envelopes refused at verification lines 0-2 (bad_envelope, payload_mismatch, bad_signature) since the connector started: they get no ack and are audited only as periodic counts

redeliveries.description: envelopes recognized at verification line 2a (canonical form already recorded) since the connector started: answered with the recorded ack/result, never executed again, with no audit line of their own (only the periodic redelivered count) and outside the budgets; a poll that brings only redeliveries or rejections puts the node in backoff

resync.description: kinds to re-send in full; empty = nothing to do. Items only match the kind PATTERN, not the enum: the node ignores (and alerts on) a kind it does not know instead of failing the whole response — the one exception to strict validation

poll_wait_s.description: long-poll wait; the node also never polls more often than once per 5 s and backs off when a poll brings only rejections or redeliveries

version_unsupported.description: JSON body of a 426 (Upgrade Required) on any route with a JSON body (enroll, renew, heartbeat, state, events, ack, result): the request's schema_version is not one the hub supports. It carries ONLY the hub's announcement and is VERSION-INVARIANT (this shape never changes, not even in a new MAJOR), so every node can read it; a 426 never consumes an enroll token. The node recomputes the highest common version: if there is one, it adopts it and re-sends the same item re-serialized (once per item); if there is none, or the re-send gets 426 again, it enters blocked_version: no poll, only a heartbeat every 10 min in its highest version with its announcement, audit line version_mismatch, until a heartbeat shows a common version. Before the enroll there is no certificate and so no heartbeat: in blocked_version the node retries the ENROLL every 60 min (each attempt audited) while its token lasts; once the hub answers 403 (token expired), only a new token brings it back.
